lib_path.description: Path to the base PicoLisp library file.

load_files.description: List of additional .l files to load after lib.l. Uses '@' prefix support if defined in PicoLisp environment, but here passed as literal paths or strings expected by (load). Note: PicoLisp substitutes '@' at runtime, so these can contain '@'. In this config, we pass the strings as-is to the (load) call in rc.

init_lisp.description: S-expressions to execute at startup for initialization logic.
